run.region: default API origin; physical processing region not exposed

definitions.total_elapsed: sum of every recorded attempt elapsed_ms plus retry_delay_ms; null if any elapsed is missing
definitions.ttft: ttft_ms is for the final successful attempt. first_visible_ms_including_retries measures first text observed across all attempts including waiting before it, even when the first stream later fails.
definitions.ITT: all assignments in the policy, including cache misses and requests completed only after retry
definitions.verified_full_hit: verified write in this unit followed by a warm read exactly equal to the calibrated breakpoint and zero new writes
definitions.verified_pair: both policies match the expected cache counters and the requested service tier on the same reported model identity, including the warm-up
definitions.cost: estimated usage cost from recorded token counters and frozen rates; null when model, service tier, rates or required counters are unknown; not a bill
definitions.pair_delta: right policy minus left policy for the same unit and visible input hash
